messages:
Ari (AE): Quick sync — Meridian wants POC creds but procurement insists on SOC2 Type II PDF, ISO network diagram, signed pen-test attestation, and a short attestation about encryption/KMS. They want turnaround in ~72h. Who can own?
Ben (SE): I can pull the ISO diagram + tech checklist. Question: will Meridian accept a redacted SOC2 extract + control narratives if we can't get NDA signed immediately?
Sofia (Security): We can provide a SOC2 executive summary and control narratives without NDA. Full SOC2 report requires NDA. Pen-test attestation: we have a standard template. We do not supply raw logs. Also we can provide a KMS separation attestation for Dedicated only.
Tess (Legal): I can sign the pen-test attestation once Security posts final language. Prefer the phrase "full report available upon execution of an NDA".
ops-bot: Provisioning note: Hosted POC staging creds typically available within 48-72h. Dedicated/VPC peering + CMK: 4-7 business days. Pricing delta: Dedicated short-term reserve ~+20-35%.
Ari (AE): Meridian's SRE asked if a limited CMK demonstration is possible on Hosted — they really want key separation in the POC.
Sofia (Security): Not on Hosted. CMK/HSM demo only on Dedicated. We can produce a short attestation stating: "When provisioned on Dedicated, customer KMS separation is enforced; Hosted provides managed keys with standard encryption controls."
Ben (SE): Action items: 1) Sofia: paste pen-test attestation template + SOC2 artifact checklist. 2) Ben: prep ISO diagram with VPC peering callout. 3) Tess: pre-approve signatory language. 4) Ari: ask Meridian for CIDR and NDA status.
Sofia (Security): Pen-test attestation template (paste):
```
Pen-test Attestation — Redwood Inference
- Customer: <Meridian>
- Environment: staging / test tenant
- Scope: API endpoints, auth flows, selected integrations (see appendix)
- Assessment Summary: Independent third-party assessment completed on <month/year>. High/critical findings were remediated or accepted with compensating controls. Full findings report available upon execution of an NDA; redacted summary may be provided without NDA.
- Signatory: Authorized Legal signatory (name)
```
Tess (Legal): That wording is fine. Replace <month/year> with assessment month and I'll sign. Confirm no raw logs shared.
Sofia (Security): Confirmed — no raw logs. We will provide executive summaries and control narratives.
Ari (AE): Meridian contact is sec-ops@meridian.io. I'll request CIDR, NDA and whether they'll accept Hosted plus a KMS attestation later. Trying to keep creds to 72h if Hosted accepted.
Ben (SE): Note: if Meridian pushes Dedicated for CMK, surface cost/time trade-off immediately. Also need contact to coordinate allowlist windows.
Ari (AE): Got it — I'll update once CIDR and NDA status back. Thanks team :thumbsup:
